newsitem.title: USA: Shell Capline May crude nominations 1.14m bpd.
newsitem.headline: Shell Capline May crude nominations 1.14m bpd.

text.p: Shell Oil Co said Thursday that nominations for May to run crude on the Capline pipeline are 1,140,885 million barrels per day (bpd), compared with an actual allocation in April of 944,445 bpd.
Capline is the major crude oil artery feeding the Midwest (Patoka, Illinois terminal) from the Gulf Coast (St. James, Louisiana terminal) with a capacity of 1.1 to 1.2 million barrels per day.
April actual allocations ran close to the nomination level of 950,000 bpd.

Capline equity owners and their respective shares include: Ashland (21.570 pct); Southcap Pipeline Co (20.998 pct); Shell Oil (13.533 pct) operator; British Petroleum (13.238 pct); Amoco (12.208 pct); USX-Marathon (11.062); and Texaco (7.391 pct).
